 Coverage by Juan Carlos Vera López Updated October 22, 2026, 12:19 am ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 12:19 AM ET 48' Oct 22 12:19 AM ET a minute ago There are no changes for the second half; the same 22 players take the field for the conclusion of this highly exciting match. "La Máquina" starts with the ball, looking to regain the lead they lost, great start.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 Key moments

 Follow VAVEL on Google 45' Oct 22 12:00 AM ET 20 minutes ago Halftime
 The first half ends with the score at 1-1 between Pachuca and Cruz Azul; it has been a great match with plenty of goal-scoring opportunities, though lacking in clinical finishing. We shall see what the second half has in store for us in this fantastic football match.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 43' 11:49 PM ET 32 minutes ago Entering the final stretch of the first half; we’ll see how much stoppage time the referee adds to this match, which is shaping up to be an exciting, back-and-forth affair—'La Máquina' currently holds possession.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 39' 11:45 PM ET 35 minutes ago Final minutes of the first half; we are 6 minutes—plus stoppage time—away from the break in what has been a very exciting match. Let’s see which team can finish this first half the strongest, great close.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 35' 11:41 PM ET 39 minutes ago We are approaching the final stretch of the first half, and the pace of the match has slowed down; the ball is being played much more in the midfield, and there are few dangerous attacks. The score remains a 1-1 draw.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 31' 11:37 PM ET 43 minutes ago We’ve reached the 30-minute mark, and Cruz Azul is pressing once again, looking to regain the lead they lost; they are trying to push the ball forward to Fernández, but so far, they haven’t been effective.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 27' 11:35 PM ET an hour ago There are many fouls being committed that prevent the ball from moving smoothly; a heavy downpour is also starting, which will make things very difficult for this match and quickly affect the condition of the pitch—we shall see how the game unfolds.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 23' 11:32 PM ET an hour ago Goal for Pachuca! The equalizer comes following a lapse by the Cementeros' defense that leaves Venegas unmarked inside the box; he finishes well to level the score in this first half—a great response from the home side.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 22' 11:27 PM ET an hour ago The team looks energized following the opening goal, continuing to press and attack in search of extending their lead; Pachuca attempts to respond but lacks clarity in the final third—the match is being played at a great pace.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 18' 11:25 PM ET an hour ago Goal for Cruz Azul! A superb long pass sets up Toro Fernández, who fires a precise cross-shot to give "La Máquina" the lead. They’ve capitalized on a dangerous attacking opportunity—now let’s see how Pachuca responds.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 14' 11:22 PM ET an hour ago Cruz Azul has struggled to create any real threat; they are now forced to defend and try to relieve the pressure applied by the Tuzos. It’s been a high-intensity match, yet still goalless—the *Cementeros* have managed to survive the first half.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10' 11:18 PM ET an hour ago It’s an end-to-end match with chances at both ends, and both teams have already managed to avoid conceding an opening goal; the game has a great tempo in this first half, which has gotten off to an exciting start.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 6' 11:14 PM ET an hour ago There’s a lot of ball possession in this phase of the match; it remains to be seen whether the team decides to try their luck with shots from outside the box and look to create their first dangerous attacking opportunities. Meanwhile, the coaches are beginning to issue instructions.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 3' 11:12 PM ET an hour ago There is a fierce battle for the ball in these opening minutes, and Cruz Azul is looking to push forward by playing long balls; the fans keep cheering, the match has a great tempo, and Pachuca is trying to win back possession.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 11:11 PM ET an hour ago Kickoff
 The first half between Pachuca and Cruz Azul is underway; this big match has kicked off, and "La Máquina" is immediately looking to apply pressure and create scoring threats—a promising start to the match in the "Bella Airosa."
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:55 PM ET an hour ago Follow Pachuca vs Cruz Azul Live Score with VAVEL!
 We will soon share the starting lineups for the live match between Pachuca and Cruz Azul, along with the latest updates coming from Estadio Hidalgo. Both teams will be looking to take a significant step forward in this Matchday 13 of Liga MX.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:48 PM ET 2 hours ago Hidalgo Stadium
 This is the home of Pachuca and one of the most significant stadiums in Liga MX. With a capacity of 25,000 spectators, it was inaugurated on February 14, 1993. It will host the match between Pachuca and Cruz Azul—a game expected to draw a full-capacity crowd, as it is one of the best matchups of the weekend. It is, without a doubt, a great stadium for a great football match.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:47 PM ET 2 hours ago All ready
 Everything is set for the start of the match; the players are ready and awaiting the signal to take the field at Estadio Hidalgo, where the ball will soon be in play for what promises to be a very exciting match.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:29 PM ET 2 hours ago End of warmup
 The players from Pachuca and Cruz Azul have finished their warm-ups and are heading back to their dressing rooms to receive final instructions from their coaches before returning to the pitch for the start of the first 45 minutes; we are just moments away from the beginning of this big match.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:28 PM ET 2 hours ago Cruz Azul lineup
 Here is the lineup for the visitors as they take on Pachuca in a highly anticipated match; they will be looking to secure all 3 points at Estadio Hidalgo. A strong lineup from the visiting side, great lineup:
